reason: rejected before any sandbox: the body uses {path}, which no precondition's probe references; a precondition is how a program declares what it needs, so a body parameter that no precondition names is a program that has not said what it requires -- the states it may fire in need not bind it

preconditions.description: Both HEAD and the upstream tracking branch have commits the other lacks, so a merge is needed.

preconditions.description: At least one dependency lock file changed on both sides since the merge base.
preconditions.name: dependency_file_collision
preconditions.probe:
base=$(git merge-base HEAD {upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch}) &&
comm -12 \
  <(git diff --name-only -z "$base" HEAD | tr '\0' '\n' | sort) \
  <(git diff --name-only -z "$base" {upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch} | tr '\0' '\n' | sort) |
grep -Eq '(^|/)(deps\.lock|[^/]+\.lock|package-lock\.json|Cargo\.lock|poetry\.lock|Gemfile\.lock|requirements\.txt|go\.sum|go\.mod|pom\.xml|build\.gradle)$'
